name: ピクセル共起分析
description: 分析します co-occurrence statistics of adjacent pixel differences を検出するために overly smooth 勾配 transitions characteristic of AI生成の images.
mechanism: Constructs co-occurrence matrices from horizontal and vertical pixel difference pairs. 測定します エントロピー of these matrices to quantify the diversity of micro-transitions. AI images typically show lower エントロピー due to smoother, more predictable 勾配 transitions.
parameters: Difference pairs: horizontal + vertical, Quantization: 8-bit, Matrix size: 256×256, Metric: joint エントロピー
accuracy: 中程度 — 68-80%、合成的な滑らかさの検出に有効
source: Fridrich & Kodovský (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting synthetic micro-texture smoothness in AI生成の content

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovský, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Captures micro-level pixel relationships
• Based on well-established steg分析 research
• 検出します subtle smoothness パターン
• Works にわたる multiple image formats
limitations:
• 計算集約的 for large images
• May miss global structural 異常
• JPEG圧縮アーティファクトに敏感
• Reduced effectiveness on very small images
